name: Howl
tagline: Lightweight editor with keyboard-centric minimalistic interface
blurb: Howl is a general purpose editor that aims to be both lightweight and fully customizable.
description:
Howl is a general purpose editor that aims to be both lightweight
and fully customizable. It is built on top of the very fast LuaJIT
runtime, and can be extended in either Lua or Moonscript. It has a
minimalistic UI driven mainly by the keyboard.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
